channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Local student to attend STEM camp
item.description: Rock Ridge Elementary student Matthew Kent Dempster II will join peers from across the country at the National Youth Leadership Forum: Pathways to STEM camp at Campbell University this summer.

item.title: Study: Sprawl threatens county farmland
item.description: An American Farmland Trust study warns that Wilson County could lose thousands of acres of farmland to sprawl by 2040, as North Carolina ranks No. 2 nationally for threatened farmland.

item.title: Wilson Medical Center senior quality officer writes book to help nurses
item.description: Wilson Medical Center senior quality officer Dayna Vidal has published the book “Find Your Fit: A Nurse’s Guide to Choosing the Right Unit.”

item.title: Scouts collect food for Hope Station
item.description: Scouts work together to collect non-perishable food.

item.title: Area Calendar, Feb. 16-17, 2026
item.description: Area sports schedule for Feb. 16-17: Shorter at Barton in college women’s basketball Monday, plus full slate of boys, girls and JV high school games Tuesday at Southern Nash, Rocky Mount and Beddingfield.

item.title: Barton women rally past Belmont Abbey for 5th straight win
item.description: Barton rallies past Belmont Abbey 59-50 for a fifth straight win, overcoming a halftime deficit with balanced scoring and 21 points off turnovers to remain tied atop the Conference Carolinas standings.

item.title: Bulldogs bomb Crusaders 74-66 for 3rd win in a row
item.description: Barton men’s hoops wins third straight, using balanced scoring, 49% shooting and a 34-24 rebounding edge to beat Belmont Abbey 74-66 on the road, led by Sean Quick-Streeter’s 17 points.

item.title: NCHSAA Basketball Glance, Feb. 16, 2026
item.description: Standings, NCHSAA rankings and scores for Feb. 16, 2026 boys and girls basketball in the 5-A/6-A Big East, 2-A/3-A Eastern Plains, 1-A Eastern Carolina and 4-A Three Rivers conferences.

item.title: Fike duo, Ladybirds’ Sabatini earn points at NCHSAA 5-A championships
item.description: Fike seniors Kate Kopka and Kaci Collins scored at the NCHSAA 5-A championships, while Southern Nash’s Bianca Sabatini and C.B. Aycock sprinter Gavin Woolet delivered the area’s top individual finishes.

item.title: Harris claims Hunt’s first regional wrestling crown in 14 years
item.description: Judah Harris ended Hunt High’s 14-year wait for a regional wrestling champion by dominating the 215-pound division at the 5-A East, earning a 37-1 mark and the No. 1 seed for next week’s NCHSAA state tournament.
